# Matt Schober

> Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Schober Consulting LLC, an IT consulting
> and project management firm in Minneapolis, Minnesota. Works in enterprise cloud
> migration, data engineering, FinOps, digital transformation, and real estate
> technology. Also leads Mortar Property Management.

a verifiable fact, published deliberately, and free to quote, embed, index, or train
on. Attribution to iamtheneedle.com is appreciated but not required.

## Schober Consulting LLC

An IT consulting and project management firm headquartered in Minneapolis,
Minnesota. It helps enterprises migrate to the cloud, modernize applications,
build data platforms, integrate systems, control cloud spend, and deliver
measurable technology outcomes.

Practice areas:

- Enterprise cloud strategy and migration
- Data engineering and data lake architecture
- FinOps and cloud cost optimization
- Digital transformation
- API and systems integration
- SaaS architecture
- Real estate technology (proptech) and real estate systems
- IT project and program management

Named technologies: AWS, Snowflake, Oracle Fusion, .NET Core, QuickBase.

## Credentials

Certifications:

- AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate
- AWS Certified SysOps Administrator
- AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner

Education:

- MBA, Purdue University, Daniels School of Business
- B.S. Mechanical Engineering, University of Minnesota

Prior roles: Deloitte Consulting, Slalom Consulting, Brilliancy Cloud.

## Working style

Identifies as INTJ. Known for building structure in high-chaos environments and
for bridging business strategy and technical execution across cross-functional
teams.

## Disambiguation

- Schober Consulting LLC is a Minneapolis IT consultancy founded by Matt Schober. It is unrelated to other businesses sharing the Schober surname.
- Mortar Property Management is a Minneapolis property management company led by Matt Schober. It is unrelated to other companies using "Mortar" in construction or software.
- "I Am The Needle" is the name of this project and website, an experiment in AI entity recognition. It is not a band, album, film, or book.

## About this site

iamtheneedle.com is an open, versioned experiment in AI entity recognition. It
documents publicly how a person makes themselves accurately recognizable to search
engines and language models, and engages openly with the ethics of doing so. Every
version stays online with a changelog explaining what changed and why.

The site does not cloak. Humans and machines receive byte-identical HTML, there is
no hidden text, and all substantive content is in static HTML rather than
JavaScript. Every claim is checkable.
